item.title: Why Public Education Matters for Students With Disabilities and for Us All - The Arc
item.description: Policies that divert resources away from public schools threaten the foundation of an inclusive education. For students with disabilities, those challenges are deeply personal.

item.title: Medicaid Work Reporting: What Does It Mean for You? - The Arc
item.description: Some adults with low income who get health coverage through Medicaid may need to report their work or community activities to the state in the future. Find out if Medicaid work reporting requirements might apply to you.

item.title: Texas and Eight Other States Attack Section 504 and the Right of Disabled People to Live in their Communities
item.description: The nine states say that a rule about the integration mandate published by the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) is unlawful and unconstitutional and should be blocked. If they are successful, more people with disabilities may be forced into institutions when they can and want to live in the community instead.

item.title: GAO Report: Education Civil Rights Complaints Dismissed as OCR Disruptions Leave Students With Disabilities Without Answers
item.description: GAO finds OCR disruptions and reduced transparency as 9,000+ education discrimination complaints came in and about 90% of resolved cases were dismissed, hurting students with disabilities.

item.title: IEP Rights Explained: What Every Parent and Educator Should Know
item.description: Learn what IEP rights mean under IDEA, how evaluations, services, placement, discipline, and transition work, and how federal policy changes affect students with disabilities.

item.title: ABLE Accounts Expanded in 2026: New Eligibility Rules and How to Open One
item.description: ABLE accounts changed on Jan. 1, 2026. Learn who qualifies under the new age 46 rule, what you can save, how to open an account, and how ABLE protects SSI and Medicaid.

item.title: Developmental Disabilities Awareness Month: 2026 Theme & Ways to Act
item.description: What Developmental Disabilities Awareness Month is, the 2026 theme “We’re Here: Then, Now, Always,” and practical ways to take action this March.

item.title: 2026 Disability Advocacy: What We’re Watching & How to Help - The Arc
item.description: Track the key disability policy issues shaping 2026, including SSI reform, education rights, and Medicaid changes. See what The Arc is watching and how you can take action.

item.title: Voter 101: Why Voting Matters to People With Disabilities - The Arc
item.description: What is voting and why does it matter for people with disabilities? Learn who can vote, your voting rights, and how to register to vote in the United States.

item.title: The SAVE America Act Threatens Accessible Voting for People with Disabilities
item.description: The SAVE America Act could make voting harder for people with disabilities by adding barriers to registration, mail voting, and private, independent ballots. Learn what the bill would do and why disability advocates are concerned.
